Nika is a screen reader for Android.

What's new in this version:
• Macros: conditions (If / Else), loops (Repeat, Repeat while), "Wait until", "Run now", export and import of macros.
• Notifications: speech template, skip emoji, limit the length, apps that are not read, notification history.
• Gesture profiles: save the gesture settings under a name and switch between sets.
Write to the developer in Telegram: report a problem or suggest an idea
